title: ExpeditionCraft
description: The perfect modpack to play expeditioncraft with.
body:
# **ExpeditionCraft Performance & Visual Modpack**

This modpack is designed to give you the best possible ExpeditionCraft experience by improving performance, visuals, and overall smoothness-without changing core gameplay.

It focuses on optimizing Minecraft while adding high-quality shader support, making your world look better and run faster at the same time. Perfect if you want a clean, enhanced experience without unnecessary complexity.

## What this modpack offers:

Significantly improved performance (higher FPS, smoother gameplay)

Shader support for better lighting, shadows, and atmosphere

Lightweight and compatible with most systems

No gameplay changes - stays true to vanilla + ExpeditionCraft

## Included mods:
- Sodium & Lithium - major performance optimizations
- Iris Shaders - enables shader support
- Smooth Coasters - smoother camera movement for coasters

## Why use this modpack?
If you want ExpeditionCraft to run better and look more immersive without installing and configuring mods yourself, this pack gives you a ready-to-use setup.

## Includes our very own MOD:
https://modrinth.com/mod/expeditioncraft-mod
